scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Seven modestly robed women appeal to a man in a sunlit stone courtyard. One holds his brown mantle, another extends an open hand, one carries a basket of bread, and another supports folded garments. Warm watercolor washes reveal woven cloth, leafy branches and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined Judean courtyard visualizes seven women appealing to one man. Their bread and folded garments represent their pledge to provide their own food and clothing; the grasped mantle expresses taking hold of him. Their sober faces evoke the plea to bear his name and have their reproach removed. The setting and appearances are illustrative conventions; the image does not show that their request was granted.
